integrity: The theorem is derived from the published characteristic factors and independently checked by exact algebra; no numerical simulation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Local linear result only; no global nonlinear eradication claim.
The continuous-treatment parameterization is an idealization and is not a clinical dosing recommendation.
Equivalent older formulations under different quiescence terminology remain a residual literature risk.
title: Exact quiescence-release law for the tumor-free spectral gap
